description:
Many basketball players are familiar with the current sticky pads on the market. It's almost universally agreed that the adhesives only last a few possessions and they are incredibly expensive before you have to buy replacement sheets.

Grip Spritz is a liquid solutions that cleans the shoes to allow athletes better grip on the court, while also elongating the overall life of the shoe. No more licking your hand to clean your shoes, just game long grip!
